01 — The year at a glance

Overview

About Me

I run TikTok Shop affiliate and paid-creator programs across a large, demanding portfolio — 20 brands managed over the year, 6 currently active, and 6 AMs supported. My core ownership spans end-to-end creator campaign execution: outreach and negotiation, budget management, sample seeding, content and compliance, and driving GMV growth on every brand on my plate. I consistently carry a heavier-than-average workload, juggling multiple high-priority, high-touch brands at once — and that consistency has earned me regular, unprompted praise from AMs, PMs, and leadership.

Self Rating

9/10
Self rating

Delivered measurable GMV and video-volume growth across nearly every brand touched, while carrying a heavier-than-average workload and being promoted mid-year to Project Manager.

Most Proud Of

Leatherman Tools closed June with affiliate GMV up 60% MoM to $108.3K. Youtheory sustained strong growth — March affiliate GMV reached $76.3K (+64%), June still closed at $55.7K (+22%). Optimum Nutrition delivered $588.4K in affiliate GMV between January and May across 15,000+ orders. PBfit's most recent quarter grew affiliate GMV 62% over the prior quarter. Megafood's video volume nearly quadrupled from February to April, pulling GMV up proportionally. Hims and Hers, built from scratch, reached $81K in affiliate GMV by December with nearly 2,000 active creators.

03 — Verified results

Performance & OKRs

Self Rating: 9 / 10

I consistently carried a heavier, more demanding brand load than average and delivered measurable GMV and video-volume growth across nearly every brand I touched — while also being promoted mid-year to Project Manager, with my manager Sumit Mane and Aman Verma calling my work "absolutely phenomenal" and citing my "dedication and consistent drive to deliver outstanding results" as playing a huge role in scaling multiple brands. That consistency under a heavy workload, paired with recognition from teammates like Sakshi Mahatekar for hitting sample targets on Mercola and Uqora, is what earns the 9 rather than a perfect 10 — there's still room to convert more of that volume into deeper brand strategy ownership next year.

Challenges & Support Needed

Biggest challenges

Frequent brand transitions requiring constant ramp-up, high-touch brands demanding sustained hands-on effort, reorganization affecting brand allocation and continuity, cross-team communication gaps, and stock/fulfillment issues bottlenecking otherwise strong campaigns.

Support that would help next year

A lighter, structured handover process to protect continuity when brands move between PMs; clearer visibility into stock/fulfillment status with a faster escalation path; a tighter communication cadence with dependent teams; recognition and resourcing scaled to high-touch brand demand; regular alignment check-ins; and an infrastructure upgrade — the current VPN (FortiClient) noticeably slows tool loads, exports, and platform actions, and a faster solution like NordLayer would recover real time every day.

04 — Building beyond the number

Growth & Contribution

Tools & Skills Picked Up This Year

Wix Dami Achuang Interactive brief-building (from Katherine Zhang) New outreach tools

Supporting the Team Beyond My Portfolio

Trained interns and helped other team members upskill on the same tools and workflows I'd picked up, so the gains weren't limited to just my own work — I also contributed hands-on to interactive brief-building for others.

Business Opportunities & Process Gaps

  • Standardizing AI-driven workflows across outreach, reporting, and data cleanup so productivity gains compound across the team.
  • A structured creator retention/tiering system rewarding top creators instead of constant re-recruiting.
  • Documented, repeatable playbooks from high-growth brands that transfer faster to new brands.
  • Clear cost-per-video and cost-per-GMV benchmarks so budget is deployed for the strongest return.
  • Tighter stock/fulfillment visibility so inventory issues stop bottlenecking performing campaigns.

Skills to Develop Next Year

  • Deeper data/analytics fluency — interpreting why GMV moves, not just reading dashboards.
  • Sharper financial and budget acumen, including ROI modeling and forecasting.
  • More exposure to brand strategy conversations tying execution to bigger-picture goals.
  • Formalizing mentoring of interns/teammates into a structured, ongoing part of the role.
